name: BCM MCP
description: MCP streamable HTTP/SSE bridge from OpenClaw to bcm-mcp-tools diagnostics.

mcpUrl.description: Full bcm-mcp-tools MCP endpoint URL. Defaults to http://bcm-mcp-tools:3001/mcp.

baseUrl.description: Alias for mcpUrl. If it does not end in /mcp, /mcp is appended.

authToken.description: Optional bearer token for authenticated bcm-mcp-tools endpoints.

allowInsecureTls.description: Allow self-signed HTTPS certificates for BCM MCP endpoints by setting NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 in the OpenClaw process.

subagentEventsUrl.description: Optional Mosaic UI endpoint that receives live BCM subagent events.

enabledTools.description: Optional allowlist of BCM OpenClaw tool names to register.

disabledTools.description: Optional list of BCM OpenClaw tool names to suppress.

mcpUrl.label: BCM MCP URL
mcpUrl.help: Full bcm-mcp-tools /mcp endpoint. In-cluster service example: http://bcm-mcp-tools:3001/mcp

authToken.label: BCM MCP bearer token
authToken.help: Bearer token when the BCM MCP server is running with authentication.

timeoutMs.label: Tool-call timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: BCM diagnostics can fan out across nodes; 120000 gives common cluster checks enough headroom.

allowInsecureTls.label: Allow self-signed TLS
allowInsecureTls.help: Use only for BCM MCP servers with self-signed HTTPS certificates.

subagentEventsUrl.label: Subagent events URL
subagentEventsUrl.help: Mosaic UI endpoint for rendering BCM as a read-only subagent panel.
